name: RxNudge
summary: Household medication reminder for reTerminal Sticky. Multi-person schedules, e-paper alarms, and offline-first.
description: Turns reTerminal Sticky into a tabletop medication reminder for one or more people. Each person has their own medicines, schedules, PIN, and history. Alarms use the buzzer and e-paper screen; taken doses cannot be retaken. Works fully offline (radio off by default). Optional Wi-Fi adds NTP time sync, a LAN web portal, OTA updates, and ntfy/webhook missed-dose alerts. Not a medical device — only a reminder aid.

compatibility.notes: Tested on reTerminal Sticky production hardware. Flash image is 16 MB (DIO, 40 MHz).

assets.previewAlt: RxNudge sleep screen on reTerminal Sticky

notes.title: Device connection
notes.description: Connect reTerminal Sticky with a USB data cable and use desktop Chrome or Edge.

notes.title: Installation
notes.description: The package writes the complete RxNudge image from flash offset 0 (DIO, 40 MHz, 16 MB).

notes.title: First setup
notes.description: After flashing, follow the on-device setup wizard (language, time zone, optional Wi-Fi, first person, optional PIN). Reminders start once the clock is set.

notes.title: Not a medical device
notes.description: RxNudge is a reminder aid only. Always follow your doctor's and pharmacist's instructions. Do not rely on it alone for critical medicines.
